svg.text: Emilia | Geometry Test 2 against frozen V3
BODY ONLY. V3 describes transition behavior. Its original paths have not been refitted to the mesh.
Lower band and bowl-like center remain.
Front silhouette and curvature do not pass.
Wrap is still interrupted by the lower band.
Rounder crest does not solve the full curve.
Sloped onset and direct return still fail.
CURVATURE: FAILED. No side verdict is based solely on onset / crest / return coordinates.
Guide diagrams are unscaled. Original 3/4 sketch orientation retained. SIDE diagram is reflected for display only.
